response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), sh AS (SELECT status, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT AVG(sh.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM sh, a WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share
